description: OpenVibe.Run's sessions on machines (the Desks plan's D6): lease one desk for one session and act on it, with a Run service token naming the session's person in X-OV-Subject. POST /api/v1/machines/:id/desk-leases (bot.desk-lease-create-request@1, answered by bot.desk-lease@1) starts a browser desk on the person's own machine where they let agents use it, or on a desk host whose owner offers its desks to other people and whose Node sandboxes every desk; POST /api/v1/machines/:id/desk-leases/:desk/commands carries screen, input and browser (bot.command@1 without desk) to that desk alone; DELETE /api/v1/machines/:id/desk-leases/:desk stops it. Bot takes it only from Run, never reaches another desk or the machine itself, and on a shared host keeps even its owner off a leased desk.
